description: Defines the PlaywrightPipeServer class which manages a server for inter-process communication via named pipes or sockets, handling connections, and initializing browser modes.

classes.name: PlaywrightPipeServer
classes.description: A server class that manages IPC connections over named pipes or sockets for Playwright.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the server with a Browser instance and sets up disconnection handling.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts listening on a specified pipe name, accepting incoming connections.

methods.name: _initPreLaunchedBrowserMode
methods.description: Initializes the server in pre-launched browser mode, returning relevant info.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the server, terminating all active connections.
